title: The reused registration number

known_project_facts.project: A trade archive assembles organization histories from annual filings and supplier records; users need stable identities and dated views.
known_project_facts.data_notes: The source says Q-41 was released after dissolution and later reused. A separate acquisition event names Marlow as a predecessor of another registered firm; some supplier rows lack event and observation dates.
known_project_facts.current_pipeline: Exact registration equality accumulates permanent unions; latest name/address replaces previous values. Deletions are ignored.
known_project_facts.constraints: Identity continuity across ordinary address/name changes is useful. Successorship and acquisition relationships must remain navigable without assuming sameness. Corrections must support replay and stable references.

explicitly_unknown: What defines legal entity continuity versus business continuity?
Which namespace, validity intervals, reuse and event dates are authoritative?
What should happen to stable IDs after correction, split, merge or deletion?
